findings.summary: Fixed dark-only palette ignores color-scheme preference
findings.evidence: Light and dark emulation produced byte-identical 415,700-byte screenshots; computed html color-scheme is normal, so the fixed dark palette does not follow the user preference.
findings.suggestedFix: Add color-scheme: light dark and preference-driven light/dark tokens.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not suppress transitions
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the probe still found many 0.15s card/link transitions and no reduction rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable or shorten non-essential transitions under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Key controls and footer text fail contrast requirements
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast screenshot was byte-identical to the default, while Lighthouse measured contrast ratios as low as 1.28:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise text/control contrast to WCAG AA and add a prefers-contrast treatment.

findings.summary: Cross-document navigation swaps abruptly
findings.evidence: Navigation is cross-document and the page exposes no view-transition styling; route changes are abrupt.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a no-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long catalogue pages lack scroll-aware orientation
findings.evidence: The category page is 7,987px tall, but its navigation remains static and provides no sticky location/progress affordance.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight sticky/scroll-state header or progress/back-to-top affordance.

findings.summary: Feedback overlays use href-less Fancybox anchors
findings.evidence: Footer feedback/share actions are href-less anchors wired through data-href and Fancybox rather than native dialog/popover controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons with native dialog/popover and declarative dismissal.

findings.summary: Reusable cards lack component-level responsiveness
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection reports container-type normal and no container-query evidence; reusable category/video cards rely on page-wide sizing.
findings.suggestedFix: Give card grids containment and use container queries for card-level adaptation.

findings.summary: Touch targets are too short and search focus is invisible
findings.evidence: Mobile probe found dozens of genre links only 20px tall, and the search input focus state has outline-style none.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase targets to at least 24 by 24 CSS px, preferably 44 by 44, and restore :focus-visible.

findings.summary: Empty search offers no recovery action
findings.evidence: Empty search only states that the list is empty, without suggestions, query correction, or a recovery action; the search field is unlabeled beyond its placeholder.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide spelling/query guidance, suggested categories, and a clear reset/browse action.

findings.summary: Redirects and synchronous delivery weaken otherwise fast loading
findings.evidence: HAR records two redirect hops before content, two parser-blocking stylesheets, and a synchronous classic main.min.js; Lighthouse reports the main document no-store policy blocks BFCache.
findings.suggestedFix: Link directly to the canonical host and defer non-critical classic scripts.

findings.summary: Substantial unused JS/CSS and duplicate tagging ship on load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 173 KiB unused JavaScript and 12 KiB unused CSS; two separate Google tag bundles contribute most waste.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate analytics, split main.js, and trim page-specific CSS.

findings.summary: Custom video player controls have no accessible semantics
findings.evidence: The custom video player is composed of empty <a> controls without href, accessible names, or native media semantics; the logo link is also unnamed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native video controls or real named buttons with states, keyboard support, and captions.

findings.summary: Main landmark and visible focus treatment are missing
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no main landmark; the search input removes its focus outline and the custom player controls have no semantic focus labels.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main and ensure every control has a visible :focus-visible style.

findings.summary: No-store responses block BFCache and DevTools reports cookie issues
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports BFCache blocked by no-store responses and two cookie issues in DevTools, although deprecations, source maps, and load-time permissions pass.
findings.suggestedFix: Review cache-control and third-party cookie behavior so history navigation can use BFCache.

findings.summary: Footer actions are uncrawlable and robots.txt is missing
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identifies two footer actions as uncrawlable href-less anchors; robots.txt returns a 404, although viewport and most links pass.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real hrefs for navigable actions and publish a valid robots.txt.

findings.summary: Host redirects conflict with missing canonical and sitemap signals
findings.evidence: The requested host redirects twice to wwwq.porno666.news, no canonical link was found, and both robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose one public canonical host, emit rel=canonical, and publish consistent robots/sitemap URLs.

findings.summary: Video pages omit VideoObject structured data
findings.evidence: The video detail has Open Graph video metadata but no JSON-LD/VideoObject structured data; the category/home probe likewise found no JSON-LD.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org VideoObject JSON-LD matching visible and Open Graph data.

findings.summary: Core browser security policies are absent
findings.evidence: HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy while retaining HSTS/frame protection.

findings.summary: Duplicate analytics create a large third-party privacy footprint
findings.evidence: Trackers found Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and region1 Google Analytics; HAR attributes 26/28 requests and 545,133/545,360 transferred bytes to non-requested origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate Google tags, justify remaining analytics, minimize fields, and load only with appropriate consent.

findings.summary: Thumbnail delivery lacks lazy, responsive, modern images
findings.evidence: Image audit finds all 48 images use legacy JPG/PNG and lack srcset; 45 below-fold images lack native loading="lazy".
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP with srcset/sizes and lazy-load below-fold thumbnails.
